_comment: September 2026 Medium security audit, findings F4 (GraphQL CSRF) and F2
(GraphQL fan-out limits), across all four frameworks. OWED: per-framework
red-first regressions landed; shared fail-closed runners pending.
status: owed — per-framework red-first regressions landed; shared runners pending

invariants.when: a mutation operation is sent over GET to the built-in route
invariants.then: it is refused (mutations are not allowed over GET); a read query over GET still works
invariants.note: Only Ruby registers a built-in GET handler that executes.

invariants.when: a POST to the built-in route carries a non-application/json content-type (e.g. text/plain)
invariants.then: it is refused with HTTP 415; an application/json POST is accepted

invariants.when: a query whose expanded selection tree (fragments expanded) exceeds TINA4_GRAPHQL_MAX_NODES is executed
invariants.then: it is rejected with a complexity error before any resolver runs

invariants.when: a query with more aliased fields than TINA4_GRAPHQL_MAX_NODES is executed
invariants.then: it is rejected with a complexity error

invariants.when: a query nested deeper than TINA4_GRAPHQL_MAX_DEPTH is parsed
invariants.then: it fails with a clean, caught depth error — never a stack overflow / SystemStackError-500 / OOM
